heading: **11 November 2025**
body:
**SELEX Checklist** 

1. Octamer Plate for lig147 NCAP-SELEX  
     
   For second octamer plate prepare \= Take 23.5 uL SBP-octamer (in 5000 uL refolding buffer:glycerol ⇒ Add 150 uL 100 mM TCEP to this mix)  
     
   First split into 416 uL per well along a row. From here add 52 uL per well into the spare octamer plate. Split this across a 4ti384 plate with 12 uL per well.  
     
2. Ligand plate for lig147, ligN40w107  
     
   For ligN40w107, take the entire mix of ligand and make up the volume to 8 mL.  
   Split into 666 uL per well along a row and then to 83 uL per well. From here aliquot to 20 uL per well of a NUNC plate.  
     
3. Complete Protein Plate for fourth quadrant of SELEX   
     
   CREB1 \- A1, MLX \- B2, ETV4 \- B12, ELK1 \- C12  
   Composite pairs \= CREB1\_ELK1 (A1\_C12), CREB1\_ETV4 (A1\_B12), ETV4\_MLX (B12\_B2)  
     
   A1-A12 	MAX 30

   c\~MYC:MAX 7.5 *(22.5)*  
   CTCF 15 *(15)*  
   TETR 3.5 *(26.5)*  
   YY1 25 *(5)*  
   ELFM2  
   ELF2m3  
   ELF2m23  
   ELF2mALL  
   DLX2

	C1-C12	FL Q3 B3-B12, C1-C2

	E1-E12	FL Q3 D3-D12, E1-E2  
	F1-F12	FL Q3 E3-E12, F1-F2

4. Re-prepare Biotin Buffer (no filtration) and aliquot to NUNC plates  
   

200 mL

| 1X TCAPT Block | 100 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| Biotin | 0.49 g |
| Imidazole | 0.68 g |
| 10 M NaOH | 120 uL |

Make up the volume to 200 mL. DO NOT filter and aliquot 25 uL per well to 8 plates (needs \~80 mL buffer).

5. Test Washer program  
   

As general rule:  
   
·   	**Rinse with water – 5 secs**  
·   	**Prime with water – 5 secs**  
·   	**Prime with buffer – 5 secs**  
**Wash**

NCAP Wash  
**no soak, with shake wash (6+6+3)**

**HT Wash**  
**soak but NO shake wash (1+6+3+6+3+1)**

6. Test PlateLoc & VWR Shaker  
7. Test Elution MultiDrop  
     
8. Set PCR programs

TW\_SELEX\_MAIN

9. Test complete recon program for single plate \- try different nucleosome plate volumes \- 10 uL, 8.3 uL, 6.6 uL, 4.9 uL, 3.2 uL (with refolding buffer:glycerol)  
10. Write and test program for Biotin Elution  
11. Write and test program for TF incubation and HIS Beads

Hia5 treatment:  
*D8*

* Prepare dHia5-1 ⇒ 1 uL enzyme in 8 uL of Hia5 buffer  
* Prepare Master-Mix \= 148 uL sample \+ 4 uL SAM \+ 8 uL dHia5  
* Aliquot 20 uL each to tubes.
